overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the current minimum or maximum row height (selector) of the list box, in the unit requested, addressed as an object-name string (via the leading '*' flag). Collection/entity-selection and array list boxes only.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box/column via an object-name string (leading '*' passed).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the current minimum or maximum row height (selector) of the list box, in the unit requested, addressed as a direct Variable reference (no leading '*'). Collection/entity-selection and array list boxes only.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box/column via a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').
